positions.title: AI Enablement & Automation Intern
positions.description:
- Interviewed finance and talent employees to uncover unmet needs, synthesized them into scoped problems, and built 3 internal AI products (finance assistant, recruiting dashboard, JD generator) in two-week Agile sprints.
- Designed and developed an end-to-end AI Assistant open to ~1,000 employees that is trained on finance docs and live Pigment API data in order to guide users on budget requests and an automated workflow for intake, logging requests, and sending updates, replacing fragmented Slack/email processes with a structured pipeline.
positions.insights: Skills: AI Integration · Automation · n8n · Data Engineering · System Integration · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Product Management · Software Product Management · User Stories
